control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 11 February 2013 a hazard report was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
